name: Mirrored Alphabet Rabbit-Hop Coordinate Algorithm
purpose: Symbolic identity, coordinate, scale-route, and reversible reconstruction-route compiler for alphabet-based rabbit hops.

packet.upward_family_shift_then_double: (N+k)*2 with k=1,2,3,...; wrap each even anchor by -1/+1
packet.upward_family_double_then_shift: 2N+k with k=1,2,3,...; preserve route-specific -/+ or +/- orientation
packet.orientation_rule: odd connectors carry up/down side information; mirror traversal may invert connector orientation and must retain a sign/orientation receipt

axes.recursive_state: identity n, even scale anchor, lower/upper odd connector, route family, sign/orientation receipt

shared_bridge: 2n+1=2(n+1)-1; retain anchor and route family to disambiguate
alphabet_orientation: A-Z or inverted rank 27-n, independent of polarity

mirror_rules.connector_inversion: mirror traversal may swap -/+ orientation; retain the inversion receipt
mirror_rules.reverse: reverse token order, do not silently complement or erase polarity

separation.coordinates: mirrored alphabet and rabbit-hop route grammar
separation.validation: two state machines and current context

claim_gate_detail: BRONZE (coordinate packet, parity inverse, and mirror grammar) / YELLOW (expanded route families, memory-rebuild integration, embodied-motion implementation)
